In a game last night, the vastly wealthy Masika took the vast
wealth action to equip with the first equipment in my library.
He already had numerous items, including a few guns, a ghoul
retainer, and a hawg. The result of the search was a sport
bike. Vast welath forces me to pay for the equipment as
normal, and equip with it, however, having a hawg prevents me
from having mopre than one vehicle, forbidding the sport bike.
Which takes precidence? I am guessing this has been asked
before, does anyone know the answer?

Q: What if Vast Wealth turns up a card the minion can't be equipped with?
For example, if a minion with a Hawg turns up a vehicle?
A: If you're prohibited from equipping the minion with that equipment,
simply burn the equipment without paying its cost. (Note that since you
don't have to pay the cost, you can't be ousted if the cost is too high.)
